result.stdout:
Domain Migration Definition (DMD) System
Usage: shift <command> [arguments]

Commands:
  apply <connection_string> <path1> [path2] ...                Apply DMD/DMDX files from paths to database
  export <connection_string> <schema> <path>                   Export database to DMD/DMDX files
  ef <sub-command> [options]                                   Entity Framework code generation
  apply-assemblies <connection_string> <dll1> [dll2] ... [filter1] [filter2] ... Apply DMD/DMDX files from assembly resources to database
  dbml <path1> [path2] ... <output-path>                       Export DMD/DMDX files to a DBML diagram for dbdiagram.io
  attributes [plugin]                                          List the plugin attributes each plugin understands

EF Commands:
  ef sql <connection-string> <output-path>                     Generate EF code from SQL Server
  ef sql-custom <connection-string> <output-path>              Generate with custom options
    [--namespace <name>] [--context <name>]
    [--interface <name>] [--base-class <name>]
  ef files <paths...> <output-path>                            Generate EF code from model files

Examples:
  shift ef sql "Server=.;Database=MyDb;" ./Generated
  shift ef sql-custom "Server=.;Database=MyDb;" ./Generated 
    --namespace MyApp.Data --context MyDbContext --interface IMyDbContext
  shift ef files ./Models/User.yaml ./Models/Order.yaml ./Generated
